recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it is a narrow source fix on active build input that restores lost navigation without changing conformance semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-7387 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested a link to documents.html from the Resource list under the Documents area because FHIR documents are represented as Bundles rather than as a separate resource type.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by fb10e5e09e250d9751b8907429f8ba0dea871c01, which changed the resource-list heading from "Documents & Lists" to a linked "Documents" heading pointing to documents.html; the Jira snapshot also records SVN revision 6449.
additional_context: Current build inputs include source/resourcelist.html and source/documents.html through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Later refactors left the current categorized Documents heading unlinked, while the old linked heading survived only in the legacy R2 Layout tab until R6 cleanup 270e0ceb7b removed that tab. FHIR-6194 is a cross-linked resource-list cleanup about removing profile/parenthetical clutter and does not conflict with a heading link. No direct or conflicting Zulip/Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/resourcelist.html so the active categorized Documents heading links to documents.html, restoring the published navigation request without adding a non-resource list entry.
source_changes: source/resourcelist.html: linked the active categorized Documents category heading to documents.html.

related_jiras.note: Cross-linked Published resource-list cleanup that supports keeping this fix to a heading link rather than adding non-resource or profile clutter.
